title: Claims preview
subtitle: Inspect destination claims for a hypothetical native user flow.
boundary: This preview does not authenticate the account or issue a token. Scopes are hypothetical, not existing consent. Linked upstream Profiles are read without requiring the user to sign in first. Profile snapshots, sessions, consent and grants are unchanged; only metadata is audited.
searchPlaceholder: Enter all or part of a username
scopesHelp: Choose allowed scopes to simulate disclosure. Changing any input clears the preview; run Preview again.
noScopes: No scopes available for this client.
evidence: Authentication evidence (amr, auth_time, acr) and issuance values (jti, expiry and timestamps) are unknown because no authentication or issuance occurs.
noReasons: No claim decisions for this destination.
sourcesHelp: Enabled sources are read through existing identity bindings for this preview only, without saving snapshots. Failed reads never fall back to old snapshots; check the source status and retry. Normal login snapshot refresh and freshness rules remain unchanged.
noSources: No Profile sources evaluated for the selected scopes.
empty: No current preview. Select a client and account, choose scopes, then run Preview.

errors.account_not_found: The account no longer exists. Search again.
errors.unsupported_client: Account-based M2M preview is unsupported, including clients with mixed user and client-credentials flows. Choose a native user-flow client.
errors.scope_not_allowed: A scope is no longer allowed or approved. Select the client again to reload scopes.
errors.account_ineligible: This account is not eligible for a native user flow. Choose another account.
